name: Tarek Voss
lore: Tarek commands with the certainty of a sealed bulkhead. His orders turn frightened crews into a line that can survive one more crossing and one more impossible objective.

abilities.name: Ashwake Step
abilities.text: At the start of your turn in a clear sector, gain +1 on your next Command check this turn.

abilities.name: Marshal's Presence
abilities.text: Once per round, after a successful objective push, reduce scenario pressure by 1 if it is above 0.
